module: Functions common to the stage start countdown (flowgraph node and test simulation): reading the environment's wall clock, countdown settings according to the rallyVisualPacenotes/rallyAudioPacenotes options, computing a countdown aligned on the next minute, freezing/unfreezing the vehicle, debug drawing of the start plane and ImGui status display in the node.
notes: Wall clock: ((tod.time + 0.5) % 1) * 86400 seconds; tod.time = 0 corresponds to noon.
getStageCountdownSettings: the defaultMaxAnnounced parameter is ignored; maxAnnounced receives defaultDuration.
In the debug plane, the Y axis is the normal: +Y is "back" (behind the line) and -Y "front".

getEnvironmentWallClockSecs.desc: Current wall-clock time of the environment, in seconds since midnight.

returns.desc: Seconds (0 if core_environment or the time is unavailable).

getStageCountdownSettings.desc: Builds the countdown settings table: duration, maxAnnounced, showVisualCountdown (rallyVisualPacenotes setting or nil), playSoundEffects (true if rallyAudioPacenotes is disabled), playVoiceCountdown (rallyAudioPacenotes setting).

calculateImmediateMinuteCountdown.desc: Prepares a countdown that ends at the next full minute of the wall clock (launch window = duration + 1 s).

buildRallyClockData.desc: Clock data for the UI: wallClockSecs, wallClockTime (24 h text via rallyUtil.formatTime24Hour) and three skip flags set to false.

drawDebugPlane.desc: Draws a purple plane (two triangles 10 m wide) with a sphere at the origin point; with normals, adds the "back" (green) and "front" (red) axes.

drawVehicleToPlaneDebug.desc: Draws the vehicle's projection onto the plane, a line and the signed distance ("past" orange if the vehicle has crossed the line, "before" green otherwise). The vec3 passed as parameters serve as buffers to avoid allocations.

drawDebugVehiclePoint.desc: Draws a small sphere at the vehicle: green if inside, red otherwise.

freezeVehicle.desc: Freezes the vehicle ('setFreeze' action true via core_vehicleBridge) during the staging phase.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle was found.
true if the vehicle was found.

drawMiddleInfo.desc: Displays in the node (drawMiddle, ImGui): TEST MODE indicator, clock, epoch, event time, remaining time, staging check, state, reschedulings, and zone/staged. Does nothing if nodeData.useImgui is false.

nodeData.desc: Node data (useImgui, test, wallClockSecs, currentEpochTime, scheduledEventTime, stagingCheckTime, state, rescheduleCount, maxReschedules, inZone, staged...).

drawMiddleProgress.desc: Node progress bar: "Running" with (duration - timer)/duration, "Done" (full) if finished, "Waiting" (empty) otherwise.
